technology_name: NANO HYDROXYAPATITE EMBEDDED POLY (LACTIC ACID) AND ETHYLENE-CO-VINYL ACETATE BASED BIODEGRADABLE AND BIOCOMPATIBLE TRANSDERMAL PATCHES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional transdermal patches use non-biodegradable synthetic backings that cause skin irritation, show poor drug permeability, and lack structural anti-inflammatory properties.
description: A multi-layered biodegradable transdermal patch structure comprising a polymer blend of poly(lactic acid) and ethylene-co-vinyl acetate embedded with nano-hydroxyapatite filler particles to control drug release rates.
applications: Targeted multi-day pharmaceutical delivery, clinical anti-inflammatory pain management patches, pediatric chronic care tracking, and wound site drug elution layers.
